responsibility: Contains the MN10300 machine description used by GCC’s RTL expanders, recognizer, scheduler, and final asm output. It defines target constants, includes predicates and constraints, declares CPU/ISA/timing/LIW attributes and automata, and provides the insn patterns, splitters, expanders, and output templates for core arithmetic, control flow, PIC setup, prologue/epilogue-related instructions, LIW bundling forms, and SETLB/Lcc loop instructions specific to this architecture family.
same_name_distinction: The RTL machine-description file for MN10300: unlike mn10300.cc it expresses instruction semantics, recognizer patterns, attributes, reservations, and asm templates in .md form rather than C++ target-hook code; unlike mn10300.h it is not the macro/configuration header; and unlike mn10300.opt it does not define command-line options. In this same-name group it is specifically the source for insn patterns such as PIC loads, LIW forms, and SETLB/Lcc loop instructions.
